newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-DSC upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-DSC upgraded to buy.

text.p: UBS Securities said analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos upgraded his rating of DSC Communications Inc to buy from hold on Wednesday.
-- raised Q2 1997 EPS estimate to $0.19 from a prior estimate of $0.17 compared to last year's Q2 EPS of $0.18.
-- raised 1997 estimate to $0.86 from $0.80 and 1998 estimate to $1.45 from $1.30.
-- said stock could hit $30 by the end of the year.

-- cited belief that switching business, which has been flat, will improve in the second half of 1997 due to growing cellular business with Japan's DDI Corp and Motorola Corp. The improvement should boost margins and earnings visibility, Theodosopoulos said in a report.
-- said margins in the access business should also improve marginally due to higher volumes of Litespan.
